rss: Drones are getting quieter as makers work on reducing buzzing noise
title: Drones Are Getting Quieter
story: DRNE is making drones quieter, so they won't disturb people with their buzzing. This way, delivering toys and candy by drone can be peaceful and fun!
storyBig: Drone makers like DRNE are investing in technology to reduce the noise of drone propellers. This could make drone deliveries more appealing to communities concerned about noise pollution.
think: How would a quieter drone change the way we use them for deliveries?
bull: Quieter drones might deliver toys and candy without waking pets!
bear: New technology can be expensive and may take time to work perfectly.

rss: Luxury cruise passengers stranded due to rising fuel costs
title: High Fuel Prices Affect Fun Trips
story: A cruise ship had to stop sailing because the fuel got too expensive. Now, they are helping passengers find other fun things to do.
storyBig: The rising costs of fuel have caused disruptions in leisure travel, exemplified by a cruise ship having to pause its voyage. This situation illustrates the impact of fluctuating fuel prices on the travel and leisure industry.
think: What happens to businesses when the price of something they need goes up?
bull: Finding new solutions can make trips even more exciting!
bear: Trips might become more expensive if costs go up.
